name: Bael
text: The first principall spirit is a king ruling in the East, called Bael . he maketh men goe Invisible, he ruleth over 66 Legions of Inferiour spirits, he appeareth in divers shapes, somtimes like a Catt, sometimes like a Toad, sometimes like a man, & sometimes in all these formes at once. he speaketh very horsly.
seal_formula: This is his Character which is to be worne as a Lamen before him who calleth him forth, or else he will not doe you homage.

name: Agares
text: The second spirit is a Duke called Agares , he is under the power of the East and cometh up in the form of a fair Old man riding upon a Crocodill, very mildly, carrying a goshawke on his fist. he maketh them runne that stand still, and fetcheth back the runnawayes. he can teach all Languages or Tongues presently, he hath power also to destroy dignities, both supernaturall & Temporall; & cause Earthquakes. he was of the order of Vertues; he hath under his government 31 Legions &c: & this is [his] seale or Charecter which is to be worne as [a] Lamen.

name: Vassago
text: The Third spirit is a mighty prince, being of the same Nature as Agares, he is called Vassago , This spirit is of a good nature, & his office is to declare things past and to come; and to discover all things hidden or lost &c: he governeth 26 Legions of spirits. This is his seal.

name: Gamigin
text: The 4th spirit is called Gamigin , a great Marquise, he appereth in the forme of a litle horse or asse and then into humane shape he putteth himself at the request of the Master and speaketh with a horse voice; he teaches all Liberall siences,4b and giveth an<d> account of the dead soules of them that dye in sin . & he ruleth over 30 Legions of Inferiours &c. This is his seal, which is to be worne by the Magician when he Invocateth.

name: Marbas
text: The 5th spirit is called Marbas -- he is a great presedent, and appeareth at first in the forme of a great Lyon: but afterwards putteth on humane shape at the Request of the Master he Answareth truly of Things hidden or secreet, he causeth deseases and cureth them againe & giveth great wisdome & knowledge in mechanicall arts, & changeth men into other shapes he governeth 36 Legions of spirits. his seal is this.

name: Valefar
text: The 6th spirit is Valefar -- he is a Mighty Duke, & appeareth in the form of a Lion wh a mans head Lowring, he is a good femiliar, but tempteth those he is femiller with to steale, he governeth 10 Legions of spirets, this is his seal to wearne constantly if you haue his familiarity. Else not.

name: Amon
text: The 7t spirit is Amon . he is a Marquis great in power & most strong, he at first appereth like a wolf with a serpents taile, vomiting out of his Mouth fleames of fire, but at the command of the Magician he putteth on the shape of a man, with dogs Teeth beset in a head like a Raven, or in a Ravens Head, hee telleth all things past & to come, and procureth love, and reconcileth controversies between friends & foes, & governeth 40 Legions of spirits, his seal is thus, which is to be worne as afforesaid.

name: Barbatos
text: The 8th spirit is called Barbatos he is a great duke & appeareth when the is in , with four Noble kings and their companions in great troops, he giveth the understanding of the singing of Birds, and the voice of other Creatures and the barking of dogs &c, he breaketh hidden treasures open, that have been Laid by the Enchantment of Magicians, & [he was] of the order of vertues, [of] which some part beareth rule still &c he knoweth all things past and to come: and reconsileth friends & those that are in power, he ruleth over 30 Legions of spirits, his seal of obedience is this. which were before you &c.

name: Paimon
text: The 9th spirit in order is Paimon ; a great king, & very Obedient to Lucifer, he appeareth in the forme of a man, sitting one a dromedary, wh a Crowne most glorious on his head. Three [There] goeth before him a host of spirits like men with Trumpets and well sounding Cymballs, and all other sorts of musicall Instruments &c. he hath a great voice, and roareth at his first comming, and his speech [voice] is such as the Magician cannot well understand, unless he compelleth him. This spirit can teach all arts and siences, and other secret Things; he can discover wt the Earth is, and wt holdeth it up in the waters, & wt the wind is or where it is, or any other Thing you desire to know, he giveth dignity and confirmeth the same, he bindeth or maketh a man subject to the Magician if he desireth it he giveth good familiars, and such as can teach all arts, he is to be observed towards the North west, he is of the order of dominions and hath 200 Legions of spirits under him, one part of them is of the order of Angells & the other of Potestates [Potentates], If you call this spirit Paimon alone you must make some offering to him & there will attend him 2 kings called Bebal & Abalam , & other spirits of the order of Potestates [Potentates] in his host are 25 Legions because all those spirits which are subject to him, are not allwayes with him unlesse the Magician compelleth them, This is his Character.

name: Buer
text: The 10th spirit is Buer , a great president and appereth in that is his shape when the is there, he teacheth Phylosophy [both] Morall & Naturall, & the Logicall arts, & the vertues of all hearbes & plants, & healeth all distempers in Man, & giveth (familiars) good familiars, he governeth over 50 Legions of spirits and this is his seale of obediance which you must weare when you call him to apperance.

name: Gusoin
text: The 11th spirit is a great & strong duke called Gusoin , he appeareth like a Xenophilus [*zenophali]13a he telleth of all things past, present & to come: he sheweth the meaning of all questions you can ask, he reconcileth friends and giveth honour and dignity to any, and ruleth over 40 Legions of Spirits. his seal is this, which weare as aforesaid &c.

name: Sitri
text: The 12th spirit is Sitri , he is a great prince & appeareth at first with a Leopards face, and wings as a griffin. But afterwards at the command of the exorcist, he putteth on a humane shape very Beautifull, Inflaming Men with womens Love, and women with mens love, and causeth them to shew themselves Naked, if he [it] be desired, &c. he governeth 60 Legions of spirits, and his seal to be worne is this.

name: Beleth
text: The 13 spirit is called Beleth , he is a mighty king and terrable, ridding on a pale horse with Trumpets and all other kinds of Musicall Instruments playing before him, he is very furious at his first apperance That is whilest the Exorcist allay his Courage, for to doe that, he must hold a hazel stick in his hand, streched forth towards the South & East quarters making a Triangle without the Circle, commanding him into it by the vertue of the Bonds & chaines of spirits hereafter following, & if he doe not come into the by your Threats, rehearse the Bounds & chaines before him, and then he will yeild obediance and come into it and doe what he is commanded by the Eorcist [Exorcist], yet he must receive him courteously, because he is a great king & doe homage to him, as the kings and princes doe that attend him, and you must have allwayes a silver Ring on the middle finger of the left hand, held against your face as they do for Amaimon, This king Beleth causeth all the love that possible may be, both of Men and women till the Master Eorcist [Exorcist] hath had his mind fullfilled &c. he is of the order of Powers and governeth 85 Legions of [102v] spirits, his Noble seal is this which is to be worne before you in the Time of working.

name: Leraye
text: The 14th spirit is called Leraye (or Leraje). he is a Marquize great in power shewing him selfe in the likeness of an archer, cladd in green carring [carrying] a Bow and quiver, he causeth all great Battles & contests, & causeth the wounds to putrifie that are [made] with arrows by archers this belongeth to he governeth 30 Legions of spirits, & his seale of obediance is this.

name: Eligor
text: The 15th spirit is called Eligor , a great duke, he appeareth in [the] form of a goodly knight carring a lance an Ensigne & a serpent, he discovereth hidden Things and knoweth things to come, & of warres and how the soulders will & shall meet, he causeth the love of Lords and great persons, and governeth 60 Legions of spirits, his seal is this, which wear or else he will not appear nor obey you &c.

name: Zepar
text: The 16th spirit is called Zepar , he is a great duke & appeareth in red apparell & armed like a souldier, his office is to cause women to love Men and to bring them togather in love he also maketh them barren, and governeth 26 Legions of Inferiour spirits, his seal is this, which he obeyeth when he seeth it.

name: Botis
text: The 17th spirit is called Botis a great president and an Earle; he appeareth at the [first] shew in the form of an ugly viper Then at the command of the Magician he putteth on humane shape, with great teeth, Two horns, carring a sharp bright sword in his hand, he telleth of all Things past and to come and reconcileth friends and foes, he governeth 60 Legions of spirits his seal is this, that he obeyeth when he seeth it.

name: Bathin
text: The 18th spirit is called Bathin , he is a mighty [and] strong duke & appeareth like a strong man with the Taile of a serpent, sitting on a paile couloured horse he knoweth the vertue of hearbes & precious stones, & can transport men suddenly from one Country into an other, he ruleth over 30 Legions of spirits his seal is thus to be made and to be worne before you.

name: Saleos
text: The 19th spirit is called Saleos , he is a great and mighty duke, & appeareth in [the] form of a gallant souldier, ridding on a Crocodile, with a dukes crowne on his head peaceably he causeth the love of women to men & men to women, he governeth 30 Legions of spirits his seal is this, which must be worne before you.

name: Purson
text: The 20th spirit is called Purson a great king; he appeareth commonly like a man with a Lyons face, carring a cruel viper in his hand, and ridding on a Bear goeing before him [are] many Trumpets sounding; he knoweth hidden things and can discover Treasures & tell all Things present past and to come; he can take a Body either humane or aiery, and answareth Truly of all Earthly Things, both secreet & devine, & of the Creation of the world, he bringeth forth good familiars, & under his government [power] are 22 Legions of spirits, partly of the order of vertues & partly of the order of Thrones, & his mark or seal is this, which he oweth obediance to & [which] must be worne by the Exorcist in [the] Time of acction.

name: Morax
text: The 21 spirit is called Morax he is a great Earle and a president, he appeareth like a great Bull with a mans face; his office is: to make men very knowling [sic] in Astronomy, and all the other Liberall siences; he can give good familiars and [very] wise, which know the vertues of hearbes & precious stones he governeth 36 Legions of spirits, & his seal is to be made Thus and worne [as aforesaid].

name: Ipos
text: The 22d spirit is called Ipos --, he is an Earle and a mighty prince, and appeareth in the forme of an angel, with a Lions head gooses feet & a haires Taile, he knoweth Things past and to come; he maketh Men witty and bold, and governeth 36 Legions of spirits, his seal or Charecter is This, which must be worne as a Lamen before you.

name: Aim
text: The 23d spirit is called Aim , a great duke and strong, he appeareth in the forme of a very handsome man in Body, [but] with 3 heads, The first like a serpent the second like a man with 2 starrs in his forehead, The Third [head] is lik a Catt; he rideeth on a viper, carring a fire brand in his hand burning, whereth [wherewith] he sets Citties Castles & greate places on fire he maketh one witty [in] all manner of wayes, and giveth true answares to privy matters, he governeth 26 Legions of Infernall spirits; his seal is thus to be made, and worne as a Lamen before you.

name: Naberius
text: The 24th spirit is called Naberius , he is a most valliant Marquiz, & appeareth in the forme of a Black Crow, fluttering about the Circle, & when he speaketh it is with a hoarse voice; he maketh men cunning in all arts & siences, but especially in the art [of] Rhetorick; he restoreth lost dignity and honours, & governeth 19 Legions of spirits his seal is this, which must be worne.

name: Glasya Labolas
text: The 25th spirit is called Glasya Labolas , he is a Mighty president & sheweth himselfe in the forme of a dog with wings like a griffin; he teacheth all arts in an Instant, and is an author of Blood shed & Manslaughter, he telleth all Things past & to come, if desired, & causeth love of friends and foes; he can make a Man goe Invisible, & he hath under his rule 36 Legions of spirits, his seal is this, the which weare as a Lamin.

name: Bune
text: The 26th spirit is called Bune , he is a strong, great & mighty duke, & appeareth in the forme of a Dragon with three heads, one like a dog, The other like a griffin; The 3d like a man, he speaketh with a high & comely voice, he changeth the places of the dead, & causeth those spirits that are under him, to gather together upon their sepulcheres, he giveth Riches to a man & maketh him wise & eloquent, he giveth true Answares to your demands, & governeth 30 Legions of spirits, his seal is this which he owneth [oweth] obedience to. first

name: Ronove
text: The 27th spirit is called Ronove , he appeareth in the forme of a Monster, he teacheth the art of Rhetorick very well, and giveth good servants knowledge of Tongues, favouer of friends & foes; he is a Marquiz & a great Earle, and there obeieth him [he commandeth] 19 Legions of spirits his seal is this.

name: Berith
text: The 28th spirit in order as salomon bound them, is named Berith . he is a Mighty great and terrable duke, he hath two other Names given to him by men of latter Times, viz: Beal & Bolfry , he appeareth like a souldier with red clothing, ridding on a red horse & a Crown of Gold upon his head he giveth True answards of things, past present & to come; you [must] use a Ring as is before spoken of Beleth in calling him forth; he can turne all mettals into Gold, he can give dignity & confirm them to Men, he speaketh with a very clear & subtill voice, he is a great Lyer and not to be Trusted much he governeth over 26 Legions of spirits his seal is this which must be worne as [a] lamin.

name: Astaroth
text: The 29th spirit in order is Named Astaroth , he is a Mighty & strong duke and appeareth in [the] forme of an unbeautifull angel, ridding on an Infernall like dragon, and carring in his right hand a viper (you must not lett him come to neare you least he doe you damage by his stinking Breath. Therefore the Exorcist must hold the Magicall Ring nere to his face and that will defend him he giveth true answares of things present past & to come & can discover all secreets; he will declare willingly how the spirits fell, if desired, & the reason of his own fall. He can make men wounderfull knowing in all Liberall siences; he rules 40 Legions of spirits, his seal is this, which weare as a Lamen before you, or else he will not obey you.

name: Forneus
text: The 30th spirit is called Forneus , he is a mighty great Marquiz, & appeareth in the forme of a great sea Monster, he Teacheth & maketh men wounderfull knowing in the art of Rhetoric he causeth men to have a good Name, and to have the understanding of Tongues; he maketh men to be beloved of their foes as well as they bee by their friends; & he governeth 29 Legions of spirits, partly of the order of Thrones and partly of angels, his seal is this to be made and worne as aforesaid &c.

name: Foras
text: The 31 spirit in order, is named Foras , he is a mighty great president & appeareth in the form of a strong man, in humane shape he can give the understanding to men how they may know the vertues of all hearbs and precious stones, & teacheth them the art [of] Logick & Ethicks in All their partes if desired, he maketh men Invisible, witty, Eloquent & to live Long; he [can] discover Treasures and recover Things lost, & he ruleth over 29 Legions of spirits, his seale or Character is thus to be made & worne as a Lamen.

name: Asmoday
text: The 32d spirit in order is called Asmoday . he is a great king, strong & powerfull; he appeareth with 3 heads, whereof the first is like a Bull The second like a Man, The Third like a Ram, [he appeareth also] with a serpents Taile, Belching or vomitting up flames of fire out of his mouth his feet are webed like a Goose, he sitteth on an Infernall dragon carring a Launce and a flagg in his hands, he is the first & chifiest under the power of Amaymon , & goeth before all others: when the Exorcist hath a mind to call him, lett it be abroad , and lett him stand on his feet all the Time of action, with his cap of [off] , for if it be on, Amaymon will deceive him, and cause all his doeing to be bewrayed, But as soone as the Exorist [Exorcist] seeth Asmoday in the shape aforesaid, he shall call him by his Name, saying, thou art Asmoday, & he will not deny it; and by & by he will bow down to the grownd &c he giveth the Ring of vertues he teacheth the art of Arithmitick, geomitry, Astronomy, and all handicrafts36b absolutly; he giveth full and True answares to your demands, he maketh a man Invisible, he showeth the place where Treasures layeth, and guardeth it if it be among the Legions of Amaymon, he governeth 72 Legions of Inferiour spirits, his seal is thus, to be made and worne as a Lamen before [thee] on your Breast.

name: Gaap
text: The 33d spirit is Gaap . he is a great president & a mighty Prince, he appeareth when the is in some [of] the Southern Signes , in a humane shape, 38 goeing before 4 great & mighty kings, as if he was a guide to conduct them along in their way. his office is to make men knowing in Phylosophy and all the Liberall siences; he can cause love or hatred, and make men Insensible he can Teach you how to consecrate those Things that belong to the dominion of Amaymon his king & can dilever [deliver] familiers out of the custody of other Magicians; and answareth Truly and perfectly of Things past present and to come, & can carry and recarry [things] most speedily from one kingdome to another, at the will and pleasure of [the] Exorcist, he ruleth over 66 Legions of spirits he was of the order of potestates [potentates]; his seal is thus to be made & to be worne as a Lamen &c.

name: Furtur
text: The 34th spirit is called Furtur [*Furfur], he is a great & mighty Earle, appearing in the forme of an hart with a firey [fiery] Taile; he never speaket [speaketh] Truth, except he be compelled or brought up within a Triangle, being compelled therein, he will take upon himselfe the forme of an angel being bidden; he speaketh with a hoarse voice, & will willingly make love between man & wife he can raise Thunder, Lightnings, Blasts and great Tempestuous stormes &c he giveth true answares both of secreet and devine Things if commanded, and ruleth over 26 Legions of spirits, his seal is this which is to be worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Marchosias
text: The 35 spirit is called Marchosias , he is a great and mighty Marquiz appering at first in [the] forme of a wolfe; having griffins wings, and a serpents Taile, vomiting up fire out of his mouth But afterwards at the command of the Exorcist, he putteth on the shape of a man, and is a strong fighter he giveth true answares to all questions, & is very faithfull to the Exorcist in doeing his Buisness, he was of the order of dominations he governeth 30 Legions of spirits, he Told his chiefe Master which was Salomon, that after 1200 yeares he hadd hopes to returne to the 7th Throne &: his seal is thus, to be made, & worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Stolas
text: The 36th spirit is called Stolas , he is a great and powerfull Prince, appearing in the shape of a Night Raven41b at first before the Exorcist, but afterwards he taketh the image of a man &c; he teacheth the Art of Astronomy, & the vertuses [sic] of hearbs & precious stones, he governeth 26 legions of spirits his seal is thus to be made & worne as a Lamin.

name: Phoenix
text: The 37th spirit is called Phoenix he his a great Marquiz & appeareth like the Bird Phoenix having a Childs voice, he singeth many sweet notes before the Exorcist, which he must not regard, but by & by he must bidd him put on humane shape, Then he will speak Mervellously of all wounderfull siences; he his a good & excellent Poet, & will be willing to doe your Request he hath hopes to returne to the 7th Throne affter 1200 yeares more, as he said to Salomon, he governeth 20 Legions of spirits, his seal is Thus to be made, & worne &c.

name: Halphas
text: The 38th spirit is called Halphas he is a great Earle and appeareth in the forme of a stock [*stork]43a <dove>, and speaketh with a hoarse voyce; his office is to build up Towers [*towns]43b & to furnish them with ammunition and weapons, and to send men of warre to places appointed; he ruleth 26 Legions of spirits; his seal is Thus to be made, & worne as a Lamen &.

name: Malphas
text: The 39th spirit in order is called Malphas , he appeareth at first in the forme like a Crow [*raven],44b But affterwardes will put on a humane shape at the request of the Exorcist & speake with a hoarse voyce; he is a mighty president and powerfull he can Build houses & high Towers & he can bring quickly artificers togather from all places of the world; he can destroy the [thy] Enemies desires or thoughts, and wt [all that] they have done; he giveth good familiars, & if you make any sacrifices to him, he will receive it kindly and willingly, But he will deceive him that doth it; he governeth 40 Legions of spirits; his seal is Thus to be made and worne as a Lamen &.

name: Raum
text: The 40th spirit is called Raum , he is an [*a great] Earle, & appeareth at first in the forme of a Crow but affterwards, at the command of the Exorcist he putteth on humane shape his office is to steale Treasures out of kings houses, and to carry it where he is commanded, & to destroy Citties, and the dignities of men; & to tell all Things past, & wt is, & wt will be; & to cause Love between friends & foes; he was of the order of Thrones, and governeth 30 Legions of spirits his seal is Thus, which make and weare as a Lamin before you.

name: Focalor
text: The 41 spirit in order is called Focalor he is a great duke & strong, & appeareth in the forme of a Man with griffins wings; his office is, to kill men, and to drown them in the waters, and to over throw [*overturn]47b ships of warre, for he hath power over both winds and seas, but he will not hurt any man or Thing, if he be commanded to the contrary by the Exorcist; he hath hopes to returne to the 7th Throne after 1000 yeares; he governeth 3 Legions of spirits, his seal is this which must be worne as a Lamin.

name: Vepar
text: The 42d spirit is Named Vepar he is a great & strong duke, & appeareth like a Mairmaid, his office is to guide the waters, & ships Ladden with armour thereon he will at the [+request of the]49b Exorcist cause the seas to be rough and stormy, and to appeare full of ships he causeth men to dye in 3 dayes with putrifying their sores and wounds, & causing wormes in them to breed &c he governeth 29 Legions of spirits, his seal is Thus to be made and worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Sabnach
text: The 43d spirit in order as Salomon commanded them into the Brazen vesel is called Sabnach he is a Mighty great Marquiz, & strong appearing in the forme of an armed souldier with a Lyons head, ridding on a pale couloured horse, his office is to build high Towers, Casteles and Citties, and to furnish them with armour, & to afflict men severall dayes with wounds & rotten sores full of wormes; he giveth good familiars at the command of the Exorcist he commandeth 50 Legions of spirits, his seal is Thus to be made, and worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Shax
text: The 44th spirit in order is named Shax , he is a great Marquize & appeareth in the forme of a stock dove, speaking with a hoarse & subtill voyce. his office is to take away the sight, hearing & understanding of any man or woman at the command of the Exorcist, & to steal money out of kings houses & carry it againe in 1200 yeares, if commanded, he will fetch horses or any Thing at the Request of the Exorcist, but he must be commanded into a Triangle first or else he will deceive him, & tell you many lyes, he can discover all Things that are hidden & not kept [=guarded] by wicked spirits, he giveth good familiars sometimes, he governeth 30 Legions of spirits his seal is thus to be made, and worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Vine
text: The 45 spirit is called Vine , he is a great king & an[d] Earle, & appeareth in the forme of a Lyon ridding on a Black horse with a viper in his hand his office is to discover Things hidden, witches, and Things present past & to come. he, at the command of the Exorcist, will build Towers, Throw down great stone walls, make waters rough with stormes &c, he governeth 35 Legions of spirits, his seal is this, which make and wear as a Lamin &c..

name: Bifrons
text: The 46th spirit is called Bifrons , he is an Earle and appeareth in the forme of a Monster at first but after a while at the command of the Exorcist he putteth on the shape of a man, his office is to make one knowing in Astrology & geomitry & other arts & siences, & Teacheth the vertues of all hearbs, precious stones & woodes, he changeth the dead Bodyes & putteth Them into one another [anothers'] places, & lighteth candeles seemingly upon the graves of the dead he hath under his command 6 Legions of spirits, his seal is this, which he will owne and submit unto &c.

name: Vual
text: The 47th spirit is called Vual . he is a great & mighty strong duke, he appeareth in the forme of a mighty dromedary at first, but after a while he putteth on humane shape, and speaketh in the Egyptian Tongue, but not perfectly ;54b his office is to procure the love of women, and to tell Things past, present and to come, and also to procure friendship betweene friends & foes, he was of the order of Potestates; he governeth 37 Legions of spirits; his seal is Thus to be made and worne as a Lamin before you &c.

name: Haagenti
text: The 48th spirit is called Haagenti , he is a great president appearing in the forme of a mighty Bull with griffins wings at first, But afterwardes at the command of the Exorcist, he putteth on humane shape &c his office is to make men wise and to Instruct them in divers Things & to Transmute all mettales into gold, & change wine into water, & water into wine; he commandeth 33 Legions of spirits; his seal is Thus made, & to be worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Procel
text: The 49th spirit is named Procel , he appeareth in the forme of an angel, he is a great & strong duke, speaking somthing mystically of hidden Things; he Teacheth the art of geometry & the Liberall siences, he at the command of the Exorcist, will make great Noises, like the running of great waters, allthough there be none he warmeth waters and distempereth Bathes &c he was of the order of potestates (as he declared to Salomon) before his fall, he governeth 48 Legions of spirits, his Character or Marke is Thus to be made, & worne as a Lamin before you.

name: Furcas
text: The 50th spirit in order is called Furcas , he is a knight & appeareth in the forme and similitude of a cruel old man with a long Beard and a hairy [*hoary] head, sitting on a pale colloured horse, with a sharpe weapon in his hand; his office is to teach the art of Phylosophy, astronomy, Rhetoricl, logick, Chyromancy & Pyromancy in all their partes perfectly, he hath under his power 20 Legions of spirits, his seal or Mark is this which make & weare as a Lamin.

name: Balam
text: The 51 spirit in order is Balam , he is a Terrable, great & powerfull king, appearing with 3 heads, The first is like a Bulls, The second like a Mans, & the Third like a Rams head he hath a serpents Taile, & Eyes flaming; riding upon a furious Beare, carrying a gosh hawke on his fist, he speaketh with a hoarse voyce, giving True answares of Things past present & to come, he maketh men to goe invisible & witty he governeth 40 Legions of spirits his seal is Thus [to be] Made, & to be worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Alloces
text: The 52d spirit [in order] is called Alloces -- he is a great & mighty strong duke, appearing in the forme of a souldier ridding on a great horse; his face is like a Lyons, very redd, having Eyes flaming, his speech is hoarse & verry Bigg; his office is to teach the art of Astronomy, & all the Liberall siences, he Bringeth good familiars & ruleth 36 Legions of spirits, his seal is Thus made, & [is] to be worne, &c.

name: Caim
text: The 53d spirit is called Caim , he is a great president & appeareth in the forme of a Bird called a Thrush at first, but after a while he putteth on the shape of a man carring in his hand a sharp sword; he seemeth to answare in Burning ashes, he is a good disputer, his office is to give men the understanding of all Birds, loweing of Bullocks, Barking of doggs & other Creatures, & also the Noise of waters, and giveth very true answares of Things to come; he was of the order of angels, & now Ruleth 30 Legions of Infernall spirits; his seal is This, which wear as a Lamin.

name: Murmur
text: The 54th spirit is in order called Murmur , he is a great duke & an Earle, & appeareth In the forme of a souldier ridding on a griffin with a dukes Crown on his head, there goeth before him two of his Ministers, with great Trumpets sounding, his office is to teach Phylosophy perfectly, & to constraine soules discesed [deceased] to come before the Exorcist to answare those things that he shall aske them, if he desireth; he was partly of the order of Thrones & partly of angels, & Ruleth now 30 Legions of spirits, his seal is this, which is to be worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Orobas
text: The 55th spirit is called Orobas , he is a mighty great prince, appearing at firist like a horse, But afterwards at the command of the Exorcist he putteth on the Image of a man, his office is to discover, all Things past, present & to come and to give dignities & places [*prelaces] & the favour of friends & foes, he giveth true answares of divinity & of the Creation of the world, he is faithfull to the Exorcist & will not suffer him to be Tempted by any spirit he governeth 20 Legions of spirits, his seal is this, which must be made & worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Gemory
text: The 56 spirit is called Gemory , he is a strong and powerfull duke appearing in The forme of a Beautifull woman, with a Dutches [Duchess] Crownett Tyed about her middle, ridding on a great Camell, his office is to tell of all Things past present & to come, and of Treasure hidden and wt it layeth in, & procureth the love of women, both young & old, he governeth 26 Legions of spirits, his seal is Thus made, & worne as a Lamin before the Exorcist in [the] Time of working.

name: Ose
text: The 57 spirit is called Ose , he is a great president & appeareth like a Leopard at first, But after a little Time he putteth on the shape of a man, his office is to make one cunning in the Leberall [liberal] siences & to give True answares of devine & secreet Things, and to chang a man in [to] any shape that the Exorcist desireth so that he that is so changed will not thinck any other Thing but that he is that Creature or Thing, he is Changed into, he governeth 3 Legions of spirits, his seal is This, which wear as a Lamin.

name: Amy
text: The 58th spirit is called Amy , he is a great president, & appeareth at first in the forme of a flaming fire, But after a while he putteth on the shape of a man, &c: his office is to make one wounderous knowing in Astrology & all the Leberall siences; he giveth good familiars & can bewray Treasures, which are kept by spirits; he governeth 36 Legions of spirits, [&] his seal is This, which wear as a Lamin &c.

name: Orias
text: The 59 spirit is named Orias , he is a great Marquiz and appeareth in the forme of a Lyon, riding on a mighty horse, with a serpents Taile, holding in his right hand 2 great serpents hissing, his office is to Teach the vertues of the starres and to know the Mansions of the planets, and how to understand their vertues, also he Transformeth men & giveth dignities and places [*prelacies], and confirmations, & the favour of friends & foes, he governeth 30 Legions of spirits, his seal is This, to be made & worne &c.

name: Vapula
text: The 60th spirit is called Vapula , he is a great mighty & strong duke, appearing in the forme of a Lyon, with griffins wings; his office is to make men knowing in all handicraft proffecsions also in Phylosophy & other siences &c he governeth 36 Legions of spirits, his seal or Character is Thus made, and is to be worneas a Lamin &c.

name: Zagan
text: The 61 spirit is called Zagan , he is a great king & president, and appeareth at first in the forme of a Bull with griffins wings, But afterwardss he putteth on humane shape, he maketh men witty, and can turne wine into water & Blood into wine, and also water into wine he can turne all mettals into Corne [coin] of that dominion the mettles are of & can make foolls wise he governeth 33 Legions of spirits; his seal is Thus made & worne as a Lamin.

name: Valac
text: The 62d spirit is called Valac , he is a mighty great president & appeareth like a Boy with angels wings, ridding on a 2 headed Dragon; his office is to give True answares of hidden Treasures, and to tell where serpents may be seene, which he will bring & dilever [deliver, discover] to the Exorcist without any force or strengeth, he governeth 30 Legions of spirits, his seal is This which must be made & worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Andras
text: The 63 spirit is called Andras , he is a great Marquiz appearing in the forme of an angell with a head like a Black night Raven, ridding upon a black strong woolf, with a sharpe bright sword flourishing in his hand, his office is to sow discords, if the Exorcist hath not a care he will kill him and his fellows, he governeth 30 Legions of spirits his seal is Thus, to be [made, and] worne as a Lamin before [thee] on you[r] Breast.

name: Flauros
text: The 64th spirit is named Flauros , he is a great duke, and appeareth at first like a mighty Terrable and strong Leopard but afterwards at the command of the Exorcist he putteth on the shape of a man with fiery Eyes and a Terrable Countenance; he giveth True answares of all Things past present & to come, but unless he be commanded into a Triangle, he will Lye in all those things and deceive or beguile the Exorcist in other Things or Buisness, he will gladly talke of divinity, and of the Creation of the world, and of his and all other spirits fall, he destroyeth and burneth those That are the Exorcist [Exorcist's] enimies if he Requesteth it, and will not suffer him to be Tempted by any spirit or otherwise; he governeth 36 Legions of spirits, his seal is Thus to be made, & worne as a Lamine &c.

name: Andrealphus
text: The 65 spirit is called Andrealphus , he is a Mighty great Marquiz appearing at first in the forme of [a] Peacock, with great Noises but afterward he putteth on humane shape, he can teach perfectly geomitry, & all Things belonging to measuring, also Astronomy, he maketh men very subtile and cunning therin, he can Transforme a Man into the likness of a Bird & he governeth 30 Legions of spirits his seal is This, which is to be worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Cimeies
text: The 66th spirit is called Cimeies he is a mighty great Marquiz strong & powerfull appearing like a valiant souldier, riding on a goodly Black horse; he ruleth over all spirits in the part[s]76b of Africa, his office is to Teach perfectly grammar Rhetoric [&] logick and to discover Treasures & Things lost or hidden, he can make a man seeme like a souldier of his own likness, he governeth 20 Legions of cheefe spirits, but more Inferior then himself his seal is Thus made, & worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Amduscias
text: The 67th spirit in order is called Amduscias , he is a strong & great duke appearing at first like an Unicorne, But afterwards at the Request of the Exorcist he standeth before him in humane shape causing Trumpets and all manner of Musicall Instruments to be heard But not seene also [causing] Trees to bend and Incline according to the Exorcist [Exorcist's] will; he giveth Excellent familiars & ruleth 29 Legions of spirits his seal is Thus formed & is to be worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Belial
text: The 68th spirit is called Belial , he is a mighty king and powerfull; he was Created next after Lucifer, & is of his order; he appeareth in the forme of a Beautiful angel sitting in a Charriot of fire, speaking with a comly voice, declaring that he fell first & amongst the worthier & wiser sort which went before Michael & other heavenly angels; his office is to distribute preferments of senatorships, and to cause favour of friends & foes, he giveth Excellent familiars & governeth 80 Legions of spirits. Note this kink [! *king] Belial must have offerings sacrafices & gifts presented to him, by the Exorcist or else he will not give True answares to his demands; But then he Tarryeth not one hour in the truth except he be constrained by devine power & his seal is Thus which is to be worne as a Lamin, before the Exorcist &c.

name: Decarabia
text: The 69 spirit is called Decarabia , he appeareth in the forme of a starre in the Pentacle at first, but afterwards at the command of the Exorcist, he putteth on the Image of a man, his office is to discover the vertues of hearbes and precious stones; and to make the similitude of all Birds to fly before the Exorcist, & to Tarry with him, singing and Drinking as Naturall Birds doe, he governeth 30 Legions of spirits, being himselfe a great Marquiz, his seal is Thus to be made, and worne as a Lamin before the Exorcist &.

name: Seere
text: The 70th spirit in order is called Seere , he is a Mighty Prince and powerfull under Amaymon, king of the East he appeareth in the forme of a Beautifull Man, riding on a strong horse with wings: his office is to goe & come, and to bring all Things to pass on a sudden & to carry & recarry any Thing where Thou wilt have it, or have it from for he can pass over the whole world in the Twinckling of an Eye, he maketh a True relation of all sorts of Theft and of Treasures hidd, and of all other things, he is Indifferent good Natured, willing to do any thing the Exorcist desireth; he governeth 26 Legions of spirits, his Mark or seal is Thus made, and is to be worne as a Lamin &c.

name: Dantalion
text: The 71 spirit is called Dantalion , he is a great & Mighty duke appearing in the forme of a Man with many faces, all like men & women, & a Booke in his right hand; his office is to Teach all arts and siences to anyone, and to declare the secreet Councelles of anyone, for he knoweth the Thoughts of all men and women, and can change them at his will, he can cause love and shew (by vision) the true similitude of anyone lett them be in wt place or part of the world they will, he governeth 36 Legions of spirits his seal is This, which is to be worne as a Lamin.

name: Andromalius
text: The 72d spirit in order is called Andromalius he is a great and Mighty Earle appearing in the form of a Man, holding a serpent in his hand, his office is to bring a Theefe & goods that are stolen, Back; and to discover all wickedness, and understand [*underhand] dealings, & to punish Theives & other wicked people, & to discover Treasure that is hidd, &c, he ruleth 36 Legions of spirits his seal is This, which make & wear as a Lamin in time of acction &c.
